name: Photo AI
summary: 创始人披露 AI 摄影工具在播客曝光后取得月度收入增长，验证了用户为可用照片付费的需求。
summaryEn: The founder reported revenue growth after a podcast appearance, indicating paid demand for usable AI photos.

metrics.label: 月收入快照（非 MRR）
metrics.labelEn: Monthly revenue snapshot, not verified MRR

sources.title: 创始人：播客后的收入纪录
sources.titleEn: Founder: revenue record after the Lex Fridman podcast
sources.supports: Photo AI 月收入 161K 美元；播客带来增长；多个产品 GPU 成本合并披露。
sources.supportsEn: Reports Photo AI revenue of US$161K/month and a podcast-driven increase; GPU costs combine multiple products.

drivers.text: 既有个人品牌和长访谈可能降低获客成本。
drivers.textEn: An established audience and a long-form interview may reduce acquisition friction.

risks: 历史短期快照，创始人提醒高峰很快回落；不能外推为当前 MRR。
收入和成本自报，GPU 成本并非该产品独立核算；不等于审计利润。
risksEn: Historical spike; the founder said the peak soon fell. It is not current MRR.
Self-reported revenue and shared GPU costs do not establish audited product profit.
soloRelevance: 独立开发者主导的可复制起点是单一照片需求；已有巨大受众不容易复制。
soloRelevanceEn: A narrow photo use case is relevant to solo builders; the founder's existing audience is harder to replicate.

name: Interior AI
summary: 面向房间照片改造的窄用途 AI 产品，创始人单独披露过收入。
summaryEn: A narrow room-redesign product with separately disclosed founder-reported revenue.

metrics.label: 月收入快照（非 MRR）
metrics.labelEn: Monthly revenue snapshot, not verified MRR

sources.title: 创始人：播客后的收入纪录
sources.titleEn: Founder: revenue record after the Lex Fridman podcast
sources.supports: Interior AI 月收入 43K 美元。
sources.supportsEn: Reports Interior AI revenue of US$43K/month.

drivers.text: 上传现有房间照片再生成设计，使用入口清楚。
drivers.textEn: Starting with an existing room photo makes the workflow easy to understand.

risks: 收入为历史自报值，不代表当前持续收入或利润。
竞争者可集成类似能力；应用价值和分发需要持续维护。
risksEn: Historical self-reported revenue does not establish current recurring revenue or profit.
Similar capabilities can be integrated by competitors, requiring continued product and distribution work.
soloRelevance: 可借鉴行业任务与上传入口的窄化，不应复制流量或利润假设。
soloRelevanceEn: A focused industry task and simple upload flow are useful solo patterns; traffic and margin assumptions need independent validation.

name: TypingMind
summary: 从改善模型聊天界面起步，通过一次性许可证与团队订阅混合收费建立付费需求。
summaryEn: Started by improving the chat interface, then monetized through a mix of one-time licenses and team subscriptions.

sources.title: TypingMind 一年收入复盘
sources.supports: 累计收入 500K 美元，订阅部分 15K MRR；BYOK 和低托管成本支持许可证模式。
sources.supportsEn: Reports US$500K cumulative revenue and US$15K subscription MRR; BYOK and low hosting costs support one-time licenses.

sources.title: Tony Dinh：与员工合作
sources.supports: 创始人说明与员工和承包商合作，不能称为始终零员工。
sources.supportsEn: The founder describes employees and contractors; this is not a permanently zero-employee business.

drivers.text: 创始人将早进入 API 界面细分市场、连续发布和成本匹配的收费方式作为关键因素。
drivers.textEn: The founder attributes traction to early entry, frequent releases, and pricing that matches ongoing costs.

risks: 累计收入、订阅 MRR 与整个产品组合收入必须分开。
底层模型产品不断改进，界面差异需要继续演化。
risksEn: Cumulative revenue, subscription MRR, and portfolio revenue must be kept separate.
As model vendors improve their products, interface differentiation must continue evolving.
soloRelevance: 单一创始人起步，但已合作用人；适合借鉴 BYOK、许可证与 B2B 订阅组合。
soloRelevanceEn: Started with one founder but used collaborators; useful patterns include BYOK, licenses, and B2B subscriptions.

name: HeadshotPro
summary: 通过职业头像这类明确交付结果获客，公开供应商访谈提供了联盟渠道收入证据。
summaryEn: A clear professional-headshot deliverable attracted customers; a supplier interview documents affiliate-channel revenue.

metrics.label: 联盟渠道月收入
metrics.period: 供应商案例发布时，日期未披露

sources.title: HeadshotPro 联盟营销收入案例
sources.supports: Rewardful 访谈创始人，称联盟贡献每月超过 50K 美元及月收入 15% 以上；供应商有商业利益。
sources.supportsEn: Rewardful's founder interview reports over US$50K/month and over 15% of revenue from affiliates; the supplier has a commercial interest.

drivers.text: 创始人认为佣金激励能让更多评测者撰文并带来品牌曝光。
drivers.textEn: The founder says commissions encourage more reviews and brand exposure.

risks: 不采用网络目录的 300K MRR 等未经直接核实数字。
联盟收入不是总收入或利润；具体时期和当前团队人数未核实。
risksEn: Unverified directory claims such as US$300K MRR are excluded.
Affiliate revenue is not total revenue or profit; the exact period and current team size are unverified.
soloRelevance: 单一创始人背景可借鉴，当前按创始人主导的小团队处理；核心经验是结果明确与联盟分发。
soloRelevanceEn: A founder-led example treated conservatively as a small team; the main patterns are a clear deliverable and affiliate distribution.

name: PDF.ai
summary: 创始人披露收购后的文档问答产品产生真实销售收入。
summaryEn: The founder reported sales revenue from an acquired document Q&A product.

metrics.label: 原帖所述 11 月收入
metrics.labelEn: Revenue in the November described by the post
metrics.period: 原帖为历史披露；年份未显式确认
metrics.periodEn: Historical post; year not explicitly verified

sources.title: Damon Chen：PDF.ai 月收入披露
sources.supports: 创始人称 11 月收入超过 60K 美元；未提供审计或独立产品成本。
sources.supportsEn: The founder reports over US$60K in November revenue without audited costs.

drivers.text: 收购已有产品可缩短从想法到付费验证的路径。
drivers.textEn: Acquiring an existing product may shorten the path to paid validation.

risks: 不能把该月收入年化成已实现全年收入或 MRR。
当前团队大小未核实，按创始人主导业务保守处理。
risksEn: One month's revenue cannot be treated as realized annual revenue or verified MRR.
Current team size is unverified; this is conservatively treated as a founder-led business.
soloRelevance: 对 Solo 有参考价值的是买入既有资产再优化；收购预算和运营能力仍是约束。
soloRelevanceEn: Relevant to solo builders as an acquisition-and-improvement strategy, subject to budget and operating capacity.

name: SiteGPT
summary: 两名创始人运行的网站客服产品，披露了累计收入和实际依赖产品的企业数。
summaryEn: A two-founder website-support product with disclosed cumulative revenue and business adoption.

metrics.label: 累计收入
metrics.period: 截至创始人该次公开披露

sources.title: SiteGPT 创始人：累计收入与企业用户
sources.titleEn: SiteGPT founder: cumulative revenue and adoption
sources.supports: 累计 500K 美元收入、135 家使用企业，创始人明确是自己与 Dheeraj 两人。
sources.supportsEn: Reports US$500K cumulative revenue and 135 businesses; names two founders working on it.

drivers.text: 把重复客服问题定位为每天发生的企业需求。
drivers.textEn: Recurring support questions frame the product around a daily business need.

risks: 自报累计数字不等于 MRR；企业人数未明确全部付费。
没有独立审计、留存或获客成本数据。
risksEn: Self-reported cumulative revenue is not MRR; not every business is explicitly confirmed paid.
No independent audit, retention, or acquisition-cost data is supplied.
soloRelevance: 这是有直接两人团队证据的样本；适合借鉴小团队与重复业务流程。
soloRelevanceEn: Direct evidence supports a two-person team; relevant patterns are team discipline and a recurring workflow.

name: AudioPen
summary: 把口述思路变成可用文字的单用途工具，具有用户市场验证和创始人收入访谈。
summaryEn: A focused tool turning spoken thoughts into usable text, with adoption evidence and a founder revenue interview.

sources.title: AudioPen 创始人访谈
sources.supports: 搜索索引中的创始人采访报告 15K–20K 月收入，正文抓取受限。
sources.supportsEn: The indexed founder interview reports US$15K–20K monthly revenue; direct page fetch was restricted.

sources.title: AudioPen 官网
sources.supports: 官网声称超过 200K 使用人数；不说明活跃或付费口径。
sources.supportsEn: Claims over 200K users without specifying paid or active users.

drivers.text: 官网清楚区分简单转写与按风格重写，强调完成文字任务。
drivers.textEn: The site distinguishes transcription from styled rewriting and focuses on a finished writing task.

risks: 收入采访正文未能抓取，需后续人工复核；用户数为公司营销口径。
竞争对手和系统级语音功能可能降低差异；当前协作人数未核实。
risksEn: The revenue interview needs follow-up verification because the full page could not be fetched; adoption is a marketing claim.
Competing and built-in voice features can erode differentiation; current collaborator count is unverified.
soloRelevance: 创始人自建的聚焦工具，比通用语音平台更贴近 Solo 产品起点。
soloRelevanceEn: A founder-built focused tool is more relevant to solo starting points than a broad voice platform.

name: My AskAI
summary: 两人团队通过嵌入现有客服流程和窄化定位获得订阅收入。
summaryEn: A two-person team earned subscription revenue by fitting a focused product into existing support workflows.

sources.title: My AskAI：两人团队达到 40K MRR
sources.titleEn: My AskAI: two-person team reaches US$40K MRR
sources.supports: Indie Hackers 搜索索引显示两人团队与 40K MRR；正文访问受限。
sources.supportsEn: Indie Hackers' indexed interview summary states a two-person team and US$40K MRR; the full page was restricted.

sources.title: My AskAI 案例及原始采访链接
sources.titleEn: My AskAI case summary and original interview link
sources.supports: 媒体复述同一创始人采访，不能当第二份独立审计。
sources.supportsEn: Repeats the same founder interview; it is not independent financial corroboration.

drivers.text: 在既有客服平台内提供较便宜的 AI 解答，可能比替换整个系统容易成交。
drivers.textEn: A lower-cost AI layer inside existing support systems may be easier to buy than a full replacement.

risks: 该数来自历史创始人采访，正文仍需人工复核。
转述媒体和目录估计并非独立证据；利润率与留存不纳入事实指标。
risksEn: This historical founder interview still needs full-page verification.
Repeating media summaries and directory estimates are not independent evidence; margins and retention are not recorded as measured facts.
soloRelevance: 两人职责分工与现有平台集成，对 Solo 加一名伙伴的创业方式有参考价值。
soloRelevanceEn: A two-person division of work and existing-platform integrations are relevant to a solo founder adding one partner.

name: Castmagic
summary: 以音视频转多种发布素材切入，联合创始人披露订阅收入和专业用户采用。
summaryEn: Turns audio and video into publishing assets; a cofounder disclosed subscription revenue and professional adoption.

metrics.label: 累计服务专业人士与创作者

sources.title: Castmagic 联合创始人里程碑
sources.supports: 帖文明确 2024 年初达到 1M ARR，并服务 35K 人；用户数不全等于付费数。
sources.supportsEn: States US$1M ARR and 35K professionals and creators served at the start of 2024; users are not necessarily paid.

drivers.text: 把单份录音扩展成多个可交付内容资产，减少重复制作步骤。
drivers.textEn: Reusing one recording for several deliverables reduces repeated production work.

risks: ARR 自报且是历史值，不等于全年已确认收入或利润。
用户总量没有活跃和付费口径；当前团队规模未核实。
risksEn: Historical self-reported ARR is not realized annual revenue or profit.
User totals lack active and paid definitions; current team size is unverified.
soloRelevance: 可借鉴先解决创作者一个重复流程再发展集成；并非单人零协作证明。
soloRelevanceEn: Relevant as a focused creator-workflow product that later adds integrations; it is not proof of a zero-collaborator business.

name: DocsBot
summary: 以企业知识为依据回答问题并连接行动，官网公开实际企业用户与命名客户。
summaryEn: Answers from business knowledge and connects actions, with disclosed business adoption and named customers.

sources.title: DocsBot 团队与关键事实
sources.supports: 官网称 3K+ 企业，并列举 Sony Network Communications、Sentry、StellarWP；照片显示五名团队成员。
sources.supportsEn: Claims 3K+ businesses and names Sony Network Communications, Sentry, and StellarWP; a team photo shows five members.

drivers.text: 引用来源、人工转交与既有客服系统集成可能提高企业信任。
drivers.textEn: Citations, human handoff, and help-desk integration may improve buyer trust.

risks: 官网用户量是公司口径，不代表全为付费或持续活跃。
没有公开收入或审计利润，按用户市场验证归类。
risksEn: Website adoption claims do not confirm that all users are paid or active.
No public audited revenue or profit is established; classification rests on market adoption.
soloRelevance: 小团队能够从一个客服知识库工作流起步；对站点问答 Agent 很相关。
soloRelevanceEn: A small team can start with one support-knowledge workflow; this is relevant to the site's advisory agent.

name: Formula Bot
summary: 从 Excel 公式生成扩展到数据分析；历史创始人访谈证明了订阅收入。
summaryEn: Expanded from Excel formulas into data analysis, with historical founder-reported subscription revenue.

sources.title: Formula Bot 创始人访谈
sources.supports: 正文自报超过 14K MRR；网页标题、摘要与正文的月收入不同，因此不使用其高额标题数字。
sources.supportsEn: The body reports over US$14K MRR; differing title and monthly-sales figures are excluded.

sources.title: Formula Bot 的低代码工作流案例
sources.supports: n8n 案例描述一个全职创始人加两名开发者；该来源为供应商案例。
sources.supportsEn: The supplier case describes one full-time founder supported by two developers.

drivers.text: 创始人称社交平台创作者和口碑帮助传播，低代码降低首次交付成本。
drivers.textEn: The founder describes creator distribution, word of mouth, and low-code delivery.

risks: 2023 年数据较旧；当前产品名称和范围已变化。
页面的月销售数字相互不一致；MRR 自报值也没有审计。
risksEn: The 2023 data is old; branding and product scope have changed.
Monthly-sales figures on the page conflict; even the selected MRR remains unaudited.
soloRelevance: 明确一名创始人加两名开发者；可借鉴高频专业任务和低代码实现。
soloRelevanceEn: Direct evidence identifies one founder and two developers; useful patterns are a frequent professional task and low-code delivery.

name: Jenni AI
summary: 多次调整定位后转向研究者和学生，创始人披露了收入与用户增长。
summaryEn: After several positioning changes, the team focused on researchers and students; the founder disclosed revenue and adoption.

sources.title: David Park：Jenni AI 创业时间线
sources.supports: 创始人称 6M ARR 和 3.5M 用户，并解释从 SEO 内容转向研究者/学生；不使用其他目录更高数字。
sources.supportsEn: Reports US$6M ARR and 3.5M users; describes the pivot from SEO content to researchers and students.

drivers.text: 创始人报告发现重度用户集中于研究者与学生，再调整产品定位和短视频传播。
drivers.textEn: The founder reports identifying researchers and students as power users, then changing positioning and short-video distribution.

risks: 历史收入为自报且非审计；用户量不是活跃或付费人数。
写作、引用准确性与使用规范决定长期信任。
risksEn: Historical revenue is self-reported and unaudited; users are not necessarily active or paid.
Writing quality, citation accuracy, and usage norms affect long-term trust.
soloRelevance: 可借鉴从真实重度用户中找细分定位；团队人数随时期变化，不能叫纯 Solo。
soloRelevanceEn: Relevant for finding a niche through actual power users; changing team size prevents treating it as purely solo.

name: CustomGPT.ai
summary: 官网披露企业采用并提供命名客户工作流，足以记录用户市场验证。
summaryEn: The company lists adoption and named customer workflows, supporting a market-adoption classification.

sources.title: CustomGPT.ai 客户案例
sources.supports: 官网称 10K+ 客户创建 Agent；付费、活跃与组织口径未说明。
sources.supportsEn: Claims 10K+ customers created agents without defining paid, active, or organizational counts.

drivers.text: 以企业自身资料形成可追溯答案，并展示具体客户任务。
drivers.textEn: Grounding answers in company materials and showing concrete customer workflows may improve adoption.

risks: 数字来自公司宣传，不是独立审计；不采用目录 ARR 估计。
当前团队人数未核实；小团队标签仅表示创始人主导参照，不能推算人均收入。
risksEn: The adoption number is a company claim; directory ARR estimates are excluded.
Current team size is unverified; the founder-led small-team label must not be used to calculate revenue per employee.
soloRelevance: 对 Solo 有参考价值的是垂直知识库和命名案例的信任构建，非公司规模复制。
soloRelevanceEn: Relevant solo patterns are a vertical knowledge base and trust from named customer evidence, rather than copying the company's scale.

name: Julius AI
summary: 让用户直接用自然语言分析数据，官网披露大量用户采用。
summaryEn: Offers natural-language data analysis, with substantial company-reported adoption.

sources.title: Julius AI 商业数据分析页面
sources.supports: 官网称 2M+ 用户并提供免费额度与付费升级，不披露收入或付费用户数。
sources.supportsEn: Claims 2M+ users and offers free limits with paid upgrades; revenue and paid-user counts are not disclosed.

drivers.text: 把分析入口从代码改为数据上传加提问，可能扩大非技术用户市场。
drivers.textEn: An upload-and-question workflow may expand access beyond technical users.

risks: 公司注册/使用口径不等于活跃、留存或付费规模。
分析正确性、敏感数据处理和运行成本需要独立验证；当前团队人数未核实。
risksEn: The company's user count does not establish activity, retention, or payment.
Analysis accuracy, sensitive-data handling, and execution cost need separate validation; team size is unverified.
soloRelevance: 适合借鉴非技术分析入口，但开放代码执行与数据隐私提高 Solo 运维门槛。
soloRelevanceEn: The nontechnical analysis flow is relevant, while code execution and data privacy raise solo operating requirements.

name: Chatbase
summary: 单一创始人起步后发展为 18 人团队，供应商客户故事披露付费需求。
summaryEn: Grew from one founder into an 18-person team, with paid traction disclosed in a supplier customer story.

sources.title: Chatbase 在 Supabase 上走向企业市场
sources.supports: 供应商案例报告 18 人、8K+ 付费客户、10M+ ARR；收入并非财务审计。
sources.supportsEn: Supplier story reports 18 people, 8K+ paying customers, and US$10M+ ARR; this is not an audit.

drivers.text: 创始人受访强调产品从吸引注意转向可靠性、信任和企业工作流。
drivers.textEn: The founder emphasizes the shift from attention to reliability, trust, and enterprise workflows.

risks: 供应商和被采访公司均有宣传利益；不能把目标 100M ARR 当成结果。
ARR 不等于利润；当前规模已不是 Solo。
risksEn: The supplier and interviewed company have promotional interests; the US$100M ARR goal is not an achieved result.
ARR is not profit, and the current business is not solo.
soloRelevance: 独立起步到小团队的连续路径有参考价值，尤其是整合基础设施以减少运营负担。
soloRelevanceEn: Relevant as a solo-to-small-team path, especially consolidating infrastructure to reduce operating burden.

name: Bolt / StackBlitz
summary: 原有团队推出自然语言建应用工具后获得快速付费和活跃用户验证。
summaryEn: An existing team launched natural-language app building and reported rapid paid and active-user traction.

sources.title: Lenny 采访 StackBlitz 创始人
sources.supports: 创始人采访称约 40M ARR、1M MAU、15–20 人团队；主持人可能是相关公司投资者。
sources.supportsEn: The founder interview reports about US$40M ARR, 1M MAU, and 15–20 people; the host may hold relevant investments.

drivers.text: 既有浏览器开发技术积累与可直接演示的生成体验可能加速采用。
drivers.textEn: Existing browser-development infrastructure and a demonstrable generated result may speed adoption.

risks: 高增长采访为历史自报；不证明净利润或低模型成本。
既有技术、团队和资金背景与首次 Solo 创业不同。
risksEn: Historical self-reported growth does not establish net profit or low model costs.
Existing technology, staff, and financing differ from a first solo venture.
soloRelevance: 可研究清楚的首次成功体验；不可照搬成熟团队的收入速度。
soloRelevanceEn: The clear first successful outcome is relevant; the revenue speed of an established team is harder to replicate.

name: Cursor
summary: 围绕开发者高频代码工作流获得付费规模和企业采用。
summaryEn: Built paid scale and enterprise adoption around developers' frequent coding workflows.

sources.title: Cursor：Series C and Scale
sources.supports: 公司公告称 500M+ ARR，超过一半 Fortune 500 企业使用；没有声称盈利。
sources.supportsEn: Reports US$500M+ ARR and use by over half the Fortune 500; it does not establish profitability.

drivers.text: 在开发者已经工作的编辑器内交付能力，减少使用切换。
drivers.textEn: Delivering AI inside the editor reduces workflow switching.

risks: ARR 是公司公告口径，不等于全年收入或利润。
大型融资公司仅作对照，模型成本与留存未单独核实。
risksEn: Company-reported ARR is not realized annual revenue or profit.
A financed company serves as a comparison; model costs and retention are not independently verified.
soloRelevance: 参考高频流程与熟悉入口；规模、融资和模型投入不适用于直接 Solo 预算。
soloRelevanceEn: Useful for studying frequent workflows and familiar entry points; financing and model investment differ from a solo budget.

name: Lovable
summary: 通过自然语言创建应用获得付费采用，官网宣布收入里程碑。
summaryEn: Natural-language app building gained paid adoption, with an official revenue milestone.

sources.title: Lovable：100M ARR 与 Agent
sources.supports: 官方公告 100M ARR；项目生成数不是付费用户数。
sources.supportsEn: Officially reports US$100M ARR; generated projects are not paying users.

drivers.text: 把创建结果和预览放在一个直接可见的体验里，可能提高激活。
drivers.textEn: Making creation and preview visible within one experience may improve activation.

risks: 公司公告未经公开审计；增长不等于盈利。
应用安全、交付可靠性和代码可维护性影响持续价值。
risksEn: The company announcement is unaudited; growth does not establish profitability.
Application security, reliable delivery, and code maintainability affect durable value.
soloRelevance: 对 Solo 站点可借鉴即时结果与模板；公司营收速度不应成为默认预测。
soloRelevanceEn: Immediate results and templates are useful site patterns; the company's revenue speed should not be a default forecast.

name: Replit
summary: 已有开发社区接入 AI Agent，官方披露年化收入和用户规模。
summaryEn: An existing development community adopted AI agents; the company disclosed annualized revenue and user scale.

metrics.label: 年化收入（非已实现全年收入）
metrics.labelEn: Annualized revenue, not realized annual revenue

sources.title: Replit 客户增长与融资公告
sources.supports: 官方称年化收入从 2.8M 增至 150M 美元，并有 40M+ 社区用户。
sources.supportsEn: Reports annualized revenue of US$150M and a community of 40M+ users.

drivers.text: 已有社区加建设、运行、部署连贯工作流，为分发和转化提供起点。
drivers.textEn: An existing community and connected build-run-deploy workflow offer a distribution base.

risks: 年化收入不能当作完成的年度营收；社区人数不等于付费人数。
历史公司与基础设施成本使其不属于 Solo 可直接复制的规模。
risksEn: Annualized revenue is not completed annual revenue; community users are not necessarily paid.
Its established company and infrastructure cost are not directly replicable solo scale.
soloRelevance: 借鉴端到端交付路径与产品内首次成果；不能假设新站同样已有分发基础。
soloRelevanceEn: Relevant for an end-to-end delivery path and first in-product result; a new site lacks the same established distribution.

name: Gamma
summary: 重新围绕 AI 设计产品后取得广泛采用；创始人称收入增长且已盈利。
summaryEn: After rebuilding around AI, the product gained broad adoption; the founder reports revenue growth and profitability.

sources.title: Gamma 创始人：建设 100M 收入业务
sources.titleEn: Gamma founder: building a US$100M business
sources.supports: 报告 100M ARR、70M 用户、50 名员工，并自称已盈利两年；没有公布审计利润额。
sources.supportsEn: Reports US$100M ARR, 70M users, and 50 employees; profitability is asserted without an audited profit amount.

drivers.text: 创始人报告在早期增长停滞后重建 AI 体验，并坚持较小团队。
drivers.textEn: The founder reports rebuilding the AI experience after stalled growth and keeping a leaner team.

risks: 盈利是创始人定性自报，不纳入可核实利润金额。
大量用户非全部付费或活跃；仍属于数十人的公司。
risksEn: Profitability is a qualitative founder claim, not a verified profit amount.
User totals are not all paid or active; this remains a company with dozens of employees.
soloRelevance: 可借鉴聚焦最终演示作品与危机中的重新定位；体量不应与 Solo 直接比较。
soloRelevanceEn: Useful for focusing on a finished presentation and repositioning during a crisis; scale is not directly comparable to solo.

name: ElevenLabs
summary: 语音模型与企业 Agent 产品获得收入验证，官方披露持续的付费扩张。
summaryEn: Voice models and enterprise agents show paid traction through official recurring-revenue disclosure.

metrics.label: ARR
metrics.period: 2026 年前四个月里程碑，2026-05-05 公布
metrics.periodEn: Reached in the first four months of 2026; announced 2026-05-05

sources.title: ElevenLabs：500M ARR 里程碑
sources.supports: 官方报告超过 500M ARR，更新页面称 2025 年底 350M ARR；不同早期公告有 330M 口径。
sources.supportsEn: Officially reports US$500M+ ARR; this updated page states US$350M at end-2025, differing from an earlier US$330M report.

drivers.text: 公司称企业在客服、销售、招聘等工作流部署语音 Agent 是增长来源。
drivers.textEn: The company attributes growth to voice agents deployed in support, sales, hiring, and other enterprise workflows.

risks: 公司 ARR 口径未经公开审计；不同公告的历史数字不完全一致。
自研模型、530 人团队及巨额资源投入不等于 Solo 模式。
risksEn: Company ARR is unaudited, and historical figures differ across announcements.
Proprietary models, a 530-person team, and large resources do not represent a solo business.
soloRelevance: 借鉴把模型能力包装成客户业务任务；Solo 更适合调用基础模型而非复制实验室。
soloRelevanceEn: Relevant for packaging model capability into customer tasks; a solo builder is more likely to use a model than replicate a lab.

name: Midjourney
summary: 图像订阅业务具有收入验证。
summaryEn: An image subscription business with reported revenue.

sources.title: CB Insights：Midjourney 收入研究
sources.supports: 搜索索引中的研究称约 200M 美元 ARR、少于 100 名员工；正文访问 403，需复核，非审计。
sources.supportsEn: Indexed research reports about US$200M ARR and fewer than 100 employees; full access returned 403. Unaudited, requiring verification.

drivers.text: 订阅可将持续图像需求转为付费。
drivers.textEn: Subscriptions monetize recurring image demand.

risks: 历史媒体口径且正文受限；ARR 不是已实现全年收入或利润。
模型公司规模与 Solo 不同，仅作对照。
risksEn: Historical media claim with restricted full access; ARR is not realized annual revenue or profit.
A model company serves as a comparison, with different resources from solo builders.
soloRelevance: 研究订阅需求，不复制模型预算。
soloRelevanceEn: Study subscription demand, not model budgets.

name: Synthesia
summary: 用 AI 视频服务企业沟通、培训和知识分享，官方披露可观付费规模。
summaryEn: Serves enterprise communication, training, and knowledge sharing through AI video, with substantial paid scale.

sources.title: Synthesia：100M ARR 公告
sources.supports: 报告 100M+ ARR、65K+ 企业；客户口径包含不同计划，未证明每个均付费。
sources.supportsEn: Reports US$100M+ ARR and 65K+ businesses; the adoption count is not a confirmed paid-customer count.

drivers.text: 企业知识与培训视频具有可重复需求，计划分层覆盖不同购买者。
drivers.textEn: Repeatable training and knowledge-video needs, with tiered plans, address different buyers.

risks: ARR 为公司自报，不证明利润。
模型、合规与企业销售资源显著高于 Solo 起步规模。
risksEn: Company-reported ARR does not establish profit.
Model, compliance, and enterprise-sales resources exceed typical solo starting scale.
soloRelevance: Solo 可从一种培训或本地化交付服务切入，参考明确业务场景。
soloRelevanceEn: A solo builder could start with one training or localization deliverable, using the clear business use case as a reference.

name: HeyGen
summary: 围绕个人形象与多语言沟通构建视频产品，官方披露收入和市场采用。
summaryEn: Builds video around personal identity and multilingual communication, with official revenue and adoption disclosure.

sources.title: HeyGen：200M ARR 里程碑
sources.supports: 报告 200M+ ARR 和 30M+ 用户；页面后续更新于 2026-09-16。
sources.supportsEn: Reports US$200M+ ARR and 30M+ users; page updated 2026-09-16.

drivers.text: 本地化和个人表达作为具体成果，可能比抽象 AI 视频能力更容易购买。
drivers.textEn: Localization and personal communication offer more concrete outcomes than a generic AI-video capability.

risks: 收入为公司公告，未核实净利润；用户不是全部付费或活跃。
肖像、授权和真实性要求增加产品与运营复杂度。
risksEn: Company-reported revenue does not establish net profit; users are not all paid or active.
Identity authorization and authenticity requirements add product and operational complexity.
soloRelevance: 可借鉴本地化垂直方案与结果导向定价；不直接复制模型研发。
soloRelevanceEn: Relevant for a vertical localization offer and outcome-oriented pricing, rather than duplicating model research.

name: Photoroom
summary: 通过易用图像处理服务获得广泛用户采用，下载规模是市场证据而非收入证明。
summaryEn: An accessible image-editing product gained broad adoption; downloads are market evidence, not revenue proof.

metrics.label: 累计下载次数（非用户数）

sources.title: Photoroom 官方产品介绍
sources.supports: 帮助中心称自 2019 年以来 150M+ 下载；未公开该页收入或付费用户数据。
sources.supportsEn: Help center reports 150M+ downloads since 2019 without revenue or paid-user data.

drivers.text: 把复杂图像编辑压缩成可重复的简单步骤，可能扩大电商与创作者采用。
drivers.textEn: Simplifying repeatable image-editing tasks may broaden adoption among sellers and creators.

risks: 下载次数不能当作独立用户、活跃用户或付费用户。
不能据此判断盈利；公司用户市场验证不代表 Solo 资源条件。
risksEn: Downloads are not unique, active, or paying users.
They do not establish profitability, and the company's adoption does not imply solo resource conditions.
soloRelevance: 可借鉴一个编辑任务与低门槛首次结果，适合作为电商工具或服务切口。
soloRelevanceEn: A single editing task and easy first result are relevant starting points for a commerce tool or service.

name: Glean
summary: 企业知识搜索扩展到 Agent 工作流，官方披露持续订阅收入。
summaryEn: Expanded enterprise knowledge search into agent workflows, with official recurring-revenue disclosure.

sources.title: Glean：200M ARR 公告
sources.supports: 官方报告 200M ARR 与超过 1K 员工；不将融资或合同目标纳入成功指标。
sources.supportsEn: Reports US$200M ARR and over 1K employees; financing and targets are not used as success metrics.

drivers.text: 深度接入企业知识与权限上下文可能增加持续使用价值。
drivers.textEn: Integrating enterprise knowledge and permission context may increase ongoing value.

risks: ARR 自报而非公开审计利润；企业销售周期与资源负担较大。
不是 Solo 案例；应作为企业版路径对照。
risksEn: Self-reported ARR is not audited profit; enterprise sales have substantial resource demands.
This is a company comparison, not a solo case.
soloRelevance: 借鉴权限、连接器和知识上下文的重要性；新站应缩小到一个可交付工作流。
soloRelevanceEn: Useful for understanding permissions, connectors, and context; a new site should narrow this to one deliverable workflow.

name: Harvey
summary: 聚焦法律和专业服务，官方披露收入、企业客户和使用增长。
summaryEn: Focuses on legal and professional services, with official revenue, customer, and usage disclosure.

sources.title: Harvey 三周年公告
sources.supports: 官方报告 100M+ ARR、500+ 客户和 350 名员工；WAU 增长为相对数，未转化成绝对人数。
sources.supportsEn: Reports US$100M+ ARR, 500+ customers, and 350 employees; relative WAU growth is not converted into an absolute count.

drivers.text: 围绕高价值专业任务和客户需求持续开发，而非通用聊天界面。
drivers.textEn: Development around valuable professional tasks and customer needs may support larger contracts.

risks: 公司公告未经公开审计；ARR 不等于利润。
法律专业准确性和企业采购门槛提高 Solo 复制难度。
risksEn: The company announcement is unaudited; ARR is not profit.
Professional accuracy and enterprise procurement increase the difficulty of solo replication.
soloRelevance: 适合研究高价值垂直任务、可信交付和明确责任边界；不应直接复制法律平台规模。
soloRelevanceEn: Relevant for valuable vertical tasks, trusted delivery, and clear responsibility boundaries, not replicating a full legal platform.

name: Fireflies.ai
summary: 会议知识转写和后续工作流产品拥有广泛采用，公司同时自报盈利。
summaryEn: Meeting transcription and follow-up workflows have broad adoption; the company also asserts profitability.

sources.title: Fireflies 市场采用公告
sources.supports: 报告 20M+ 人、500K+ 组织、100 名员工，并称自 2023 年起盈利；未公布可审计利润金额。
sources.supportsEn: Reports 20M+ people, 500K+ organizations, and 100 employees; asserts profitability since 2023 without an audited amount.

drivers.text: 连接多种会议平台并把记录转为可搜索知识与行动，可能形成重复使用。
drivers.textEn: Meeting-platform integration and turning records into searchable knowledge and actions may encourage repeat use.

risks: 用户和组织总量不等于付费或活跃用户；盈利是公司定性声明。
会议平台自带 AI、隐私要求和录音授权影响差异与运营。
risksEn: People and organizations are not confirmed paid or active users; profitability is a qualitative company claim.
Built-in platform AI, privacy, and recording authorization affect differentiation and operations.
soloRelevance: 可借鉴从记录延伸到完成工作，Solo 宜选择一个细分会议场景。
soloRelevanceEn: Useful for progressing from notes to completed work; a solo builder should choose one meeting niche.

name: Cydoc
summary: 单人创始人主导的医疗 AI 公司于 2025 年 8 月决定关闭；获得付费客户和临床验证，但未形成可持续销售与交付体系。

metrics.label: 亲友与医生投资（创始人自述）
metrics.labelEn: Investment from family, friends and physicians (founder report)

sources.title: Why I Shut Down My Bootstrapped Health AI Startup After 7 Years
sources.supports: 2025 年 8 月关闭、4 家付费客户、投资金额，以及客户发现、MVP、销售和工作流问题。
sources.titleEn: Why I Shut Down My Bootstrapped Health AI Startup After 7 Years
sources.supportsEn: Closure in August 2025, four paying customers, investment, and problems with customer discovery, MVP scope, sales and workflow.

drivers.text: 客户访谈与预付费验证太晚，早期开发了客户不需要的功能。
drivers.textEn: Customer interviews and prepayment validation came too late; early development included features customers did not need.

drivers.text: 创始人兼顾产品、技术和销售，缺乏持续获客体系及临床工作流整合。
drivers.textEn: The founder covered product, engineering and sales, without a repeatable acquisition system or enough workflow integration.

risks: 经营数字来自创始人自述，未经独立财务审计。
solo 指单人创始人主导；实际使用过实习生和外包工程师。
医疗行业的合规与采购条件不能直接外推到普通 SaaS。
soloRelevance: 高：先验证付费需求、缩小 MVP、把工作流接入和销售投入纳入资源预算。
summaryEn: A health AI company led by a solo founder decided to close in August 2025. It had paying customers and clinical validation, but did not establish sustainable sales and delivery.
soloRelevanceEn: High: validate paid demand early, narrow the MVP, and budget for workflow integration and sales.
risksEn: Operating figures are founder reports without an independent financial audit.
Solo means a solo founder; interns and contract engineers also contributed.
Healthcare compliance and procurement conditions do not directly transfer to ordinary SaaS.

name: Content Goblin
category: AI 内容 / Pinterest 增长
summary: 一位开发者与推广合伙人经营的 AI 内容工具曾获得订阅营收，后因持续流失、渠道变化和成本压力宣布停运；失败指后续经营终止，不否定早期营收。

metrics.label: 衰退后 MRR（创始人自述）
metrics.period: 停运决策前，具体日期未披露
metrics.periodEn: Before the closure decision; exact date undisclosed

sources.title: I'm Shutting Down Content Goblin – A Post Mortem
sources.supports: 产品、MRR、持续流失、推广渠道依赖、付费获客成本、AI 成本及宣布停运。
sources.titleEn: I'm Shutting Down Content Goblin – A Post Mortem
sources.supportsEn: Product, MRR, churn, acquisition-channel dependence, paid acquisition, AI costs and the closure announcement.

drivers.text: 初期增长依赖推广合伙人的 YouTube 受众，渠道转向后缺乏替代流量。
drivers.textEn: Initial growth depended on a partner's YouTube audience; the business lacked replacement traffic when that channel changed direction.

drivers.text: 用户变现渠道变化伴随订阅取消，付费获客需要更长留存才能回本。
drivers.textEn: Changes to users' monetization channels coincided with cancellations, while paid acquisition required longer retention to repay its cost.

drivers.text: 持续流失、模型服务成本与创始人支持负担令经营回报不足。
drivers.textEn: Churn, model-provider costs and founder support demands reduced the return from continuing the business.

risks: 来源 2026 年发布但写停运决定在 2025 年 7 月，又描述 2025 年 8 月事件，存在时间线冲突；不使用确切停运日期。
MRR 和原因均为创始人自述。
来源称后期仍略有利润，不能把停运简化为从未赚钱。
soloRelevance: 高：跟踪净留存、获客回本和创始人时间；避免只依赖一位达人或一条内容平台。
summaryEn: An AI content tool run by a developer and a marketing partner earned subscription revenue before announcing closure following churn, channel changes and cost pressure. Later closure does not erase its earlier revenue.
soloRelevanceEn: High: track net retention, acquisition payback and founder time; avoid dependence on one influencer or content platform.
risksEn: The article was published in 2026 but places the closure decision in July 2025 and also describes August 2025 events. The timeline conflicts, so no exact closure date is used.
MRR and explanations are founder reports.
The founder says the business remained slightly profitable late in its life; closure does not mean it never earned money.

name: Kite
summary: 早于 Copilot 的 AI 编程助手于 2022 年宣布结束支持；有大量开发者使用，但未建立足够的付费转化。

metrics.label: 活跃开发者（创始人经媒体引用）

sources.title: Kite AI coding pulled down to earth … now open source
sources.supports: 公司停运、约 15 人团队、50 万活跃开发者和创始人对技术与营收问题的复盘。
sources.titleEn: Kite AI coding pulled down to earth … now open source
sources.supportsEn: Closure, a team of about 15, 500,000 active developers, and the founder's account of technical and monetization problems.

drivers.text: 开发周期长，免费用户规模未转化为足以维持经营的收入。
drivers.textEn: Development took years, and the free user base did not generate sufficient revenue to sustain operations.

risks: 2022 年旧案例，技术与市场条件已变化。
创始人当时称个人开发者不愿付费，这是其诊断；后续付费 AI 编程市场提供反例。
活跃用户不等于付费客户或利润。
soloRelevance: 高：免费增长和付费转化分开验证，尽早测试谁购买及采购方式。
summaryEn: This AI coding assistant predated Copilot and ended support in 2022. A large developer audience did not produce enough paid conversion to sustain the business.
soloRelevanceEn: High: validate free adoption separately from paid conversion, and test the buyer and procurement path early.
risksEn: A historical 2022 case; technology and market conditions have changed.
The founder's claim that individual developers do not pay was his diagnosis; later paid AI coding products provide counterexamples.
Active users are not paying customers or profit.

name: Coqui AI
summary: Coqui 创始人于 2024 年 1 月公开宣布公司关闭；开源 TTS 技术与商业公司状态需要分别观察。

sources.title: Coqui is shutting down
sources.supports: 小团队公司关闭、2023 年 Studio 与 API 商业服务，以及开源模型继续可用。
sources.supportsEn: Small-team company closure, the Studio and API launched in 2023, and continued availability of open-source models.

drivers.text: 技术影响和开源社区规模不能单独证明商业服务可持续；具体停运根因未在告别文章披露。
drivers.textEn: Technical impact and an open-source community do not by themselves establish commercial sustainability; the farewell did not disclose a specific root cause.

risks: 官方告别文章未披露营收、留存或精确失败根因，不将资金短缺当作已证实事实。
开源社区项目仍可存续，失败范围为公司商业运营。
soloRelevance: 中高：把开源采用、商业客户及付费服务成本作为三组独立指标。
summaryEn: A Coqui founder announced the company's closure in January 2024. Its open-source TTS technology and the commercial company must be tracked separately.
soloRelevanceEn: Medium to high: track open-source adoption, commercial customers and paid-service costs as separate indicators.
risksEn: The official farewell does not disclose revenue, retention or a precise root cause; funding shortage is not recorded as a confirmed fact.
Community projects can continue; the failure scope is company commercial operations.

name: Tome Slides
summary: Tome 官方宣布 Slides 于 2025 年 4 月 30 日停止访问，并表示没有找到把产品变成可行生意的方法；范围限于 Slides 产品。

sources.title: Tome Slides is Sunsetting on April 30th, 2025
sources.supports: Slides 结束日期、商业化未跑通、取消订阅及删除用户文件的安排。
sources.titleEn: Tome Slides is Sunsetting on April 30th, 2025
sources.supportsEn: Slides end date, unsuccessful commercialization, subscription cancellations and deletion of user files.

drivers.text: 团队公开表示尝试改进产品和商业化后，仍未找到能运作的经营方式。
drivers.textEn: The team reported that efforts to improve and commercialize the product did not produce a workable business.

risks: 具体收入、利润和停运根因未在该公告披露。
产品停运不等于 Tome 公司全部业务失败。
soloRelevance: 高：用户喜爱产品后仍需验证定价、交付成本与经常性需求。
summaryEn: Tome announced that Slides would stop being accessible on April 30, 2025, saying it had not found a way to make the product a workable business. The scope is the Slides product.
soloRelevanceEn: High: after users like a product, validate pricing, delivery costs and recurring demand.
risksEn: The notice does not disclose precise revenue, profit or detailed causes.
Product retirement does not mean every Tome business failed.

name: Humane AI Pin
category: AI 硬件 / 个人助手
summary: AI Pin 核心云服务于 2025 年 2 月 28 日结束；HP 取得部分软件、人才与知识产权，消费硬件业务停运。

sources.title: Ai Pin Consumers FAQ
sources.supports: 2025 年 2 月 28 日停止支持和核心服务。
sources.supportsEn: End of support and core service on February 28, 2025.

sources.title: Humane is shutting down the AI Pin and selling its remnants to HP
sources.supports: 交易金额、消费硬件结束，以及产品可靠性和市场表现报道。
sources.titleEn: Humane is shutting down the AI Pin and selling its remnants to HP
sources.supportsEn: Transaction value, consumer hardware retirement, and reporting on reliability and market response.

drivers.text: 媒体报道产品体验问题和退货压力，削弱了面向消费者的付费价值。
drivers.textEn: Media reported product-experience problems and return pressure that weakened consumer value.

drivers.text: 依赖持续云服务的硬件需要在商业模型中覆盖长期服务义务。
drivers.textEn: Cloud-dependent hardware needs a business model that pays for long-term service obligations.

risks: 收购本身不是失败判据；这里记录明确停运的 AI Pin 产品。
交易金额是资产交易，不是营收或利润。
资本密集硬件案例不宜直接用于预测 solo SaaS 成功率。
soloRelevance: 中：先兑现稳定的核心任务，计入长期服务成本和退出时的数据迁移。
summaryEn: AI Pin's core cloud services ended on February 28, 2025. HP acquired some software, staff and intellectual property, while the consumer hardware business wound down.
soloRelevanceEn: Medium: deliver a reliable core task and budget for long-term service and data migration on exit.
risksEn: An acquisition is not the failure criterion; this record concerns the explicitly retired AI Pin product.
The transaction value is an asset deal, not revenue or profit.
Capital-intensive hardware should not directly predict solo SaaS success.

name: Neeva 消费者搜索
summary: Neeva 于 2023 年退出消费者搜索并转向企业方向；失败范围为消费者订阅搜索路线，不是后续技术资产价值。

sources.title: Neeva, The Ad-Free Search Engine, Announces Closure
sources.titleEn: Neeva, The Ad-Free Search Engine, Announces Closure
sources.supports: 消费者搜索关闭、可持续经营问题和转向企业。
sources.supportsEn: Consumer-search closure, sustainability problems and enterprise pivot.

sources.title: Neeva is shutting down its ads-free search engine
sources.titleEn: Neeva is shutting down its ads-free search engine
sources.supports: 6 月 2 日关闭及创始人对获客、市场和资金环境的判断。
sources.supportsEn: June 2 closure and the founders' account of acquisition, market and funding challenges.

sources.title: Neeva, Upstart Search Engine, Shuts Down
sources.titleEn: Neeva, Upstart Search Engine, Shuts Down
sources.supports: 转录创始人公开说明：让用户试用和更改默认搜索比说服已采用用户付费更困难。
sources.supportsEn: Reproduces the founders' explanation that adoption and switching defaults were harder than convincing adopters to pay.

drivers.text: 创始人称获客和改变默认搜索习惯困难，结合资金及市场环境，消费者搜索已没有可持续经营路径。
drivers.textEn: The founders cited difficult acquisition and default-search switching, alongside funding and market conditions, leaving no sustainable consumer-search path.

drivers.text: 创始人表示说服用户试用比说服已采用用户付费更困难，因此不能简单归因为用户不愿付费。
drivers.textEn: The founders said getting users to try it was harder than getting adopters to pay; unwillingness to pay is not a sufficient explanation.

risks: 2023 年市场状态。
业务退出和技术被收购可以同时发生，不把收购归为失败。
soloRelevance: 中高：与默认免费工具竞争时，验证用户为何切换及持续付费。
summaryEn: Neeva exited consumer search in 2023 and shifted toward enterprise services. This record concerns the consumer subscription search route, not the subsequent value of its technology.
soloRelevanceEn: Medium to high: when competing with a default free tool, validate why users switch and keep paying.
risksEn: Reflects the market in 2023.
A business exit and technology acquisition can occur together; an acquisition is not treated as failure.

name: Artifact 独立新闻应用
summary: 创始人先宣布结束独立新闻应用；2024 年 Yahoo 收购其技术，独立 app 不再继续。范围为独立产品路线。

sources.title: Instagram co-founders’ AI-powered news app Artifact shutting down
sources.supports: 创始人解释独立应用市场机会不足以支持继续投资。
sources.titleEn: Instagram co-founders’ AI-powered news app Artifact shutting down
sources.supportsEn: The founders' explanation that the independent app's market opportunity did not warrant continued investment.

sources.title: Yahoo announces the acquisition of Artifact
sources.supports: Yahoo 收购技术及独立应用结束后的技术整合安排。
sources.titleEn: Yahoo announces the acquisition of Artifact
sources.supportsEn: Yahoo's technology acquisition and the post-app integration plan.

drivers.text: 创始人称市场机会不足以支撑继续投入独立产品。
drivers.textEn: The founders said the market opportunity did not warrant continued investment in the standalone product.

risks: 不把 Yahoo 收购本身当作商业失败。
独立应用失败不代表推荐技术没有价值；用户喜爱与创业规模门槛不同。
团队人数在选用资料中未确认，small-team 为创业团队规模标签而非审计数据。
soloRelevance: 高：定义自己的可持续营收目标，避免照搬融资公司要求的大市场规模。
summaryEn: The founders announced an end to the independent news app. Yahoo acquired the technology in 2024 and the standalone app did not continue. The scope is the independent product route.
soloRelevanceEn: High: set your own sustainable revenue target rather than adopting a venture-funded company's market-size threshold.
risksEn: Yahoo's acquisition is not itself treated as a commercial failure.
The independent app's end does not mean its recommendation technology lacked value; user affection and venture-scale market size differ.
The selected sources do not verify headcount; small-team is a startup-scale tag, not an audited figure.

name: Olive AI
category: 医疗 AI / 流程自动化
summary: Olive 于 2023 年 10 月出售核心业务并关闭剩余运营；已有医院部署，仍未能维持原公司的经营。

metrics.label: 医院部署（当时管理层声称）

sources.title: Olive AI sells two key businesses, winds down operations
sources.supports: 关停、资产处置、医院部署的历史声称，以及 CEO 承认增长过快和缺乏聚焦。
sources.titleEn: Olive AI sells two key businesses, winds down operations
sources.supportsEn: Closure, asset sales, historical hospital-deployment claim, and the CEO's account of excessive growth and lack of focus.

drivers.text: CEO 承认增长过快和缺乏聚焦挤压产品与工程资源，妨碍关键执行。
drivers.textEn: The CEO acknowledged that fast growth and lack of focus strained product and engineering resources and delayed key execution.

risks: 历史医院部署是公司当时声称，不能视为付费客户留存或 ROI 审计。
卖出的业务可能继续服务客户；失败范围为原公司剩余运营。
soloRelevance: 中：控制产品广度，验证每个自动化工作流的实施成本和客户价值。
summaryEn: Olive sold its core business units and wound down remaining operations in October 2023. Hospital deployments did not ensure sustainability of the original company.
soloRelevanceEn: Medium: control product breadth and validate implementation cost and customer value for each automated workflow.
risksEn: Hospital deployments were a historical company claim, not an audit of paid retention or ROI.
Sold business units may continue serving customers; the scope is the original company's remaining operations.

name: Builder.ai
category: AI 软件开发 / 无代码
summary: Builder.ai 于 2025 年 5 月公开宣布进入资不抵债处置程序；记录明确财务困境，不把所有 AI 软件开发路线判为失败。

sources.title: Builder.ai announces insolvency proceedings
sources.supports: 公司明确进入 insolvency 程序，并称历史挑战与决策压迫财务状况。
sources.supportsEn: Company confirmation of insolvency proceedings and its statement about historical financial pressures.

sources.title: Microsoft-backed no-code AI startup files for bankruptcy
sources.supports: 2025 年 5 月宣布程序及公司业务背景。
sources.titleEn: Microsoft-backed no-code AI startup files for bankruptcy
sources.supportsEn: Timing of the May 2025 announcement and business background.

drivers.text: 公司称历史挑战与以往决策使财务状况承受重大压力，未能恢复。
drivers.textEn: The company said historic challenges and past decisions put significant strain on its financial position and it could not recover.

risks: insolvency 不自动等同所有法人已解散；标签为重大商业挫折。
历史营收存在公开争议，未纳入未核实金额。
不将媒体指控当作已裁决事实。
soloRelevance: 中：核验收入质量、现金余额、履约义务与产品宣传能否实际兑现。
summaryEn: Builder.ai announced insolvency proceedings in May 2025. This is a documented financial setback, not evidence that every AI software-development route fails.
soloRelevanceEn: Medium: verify revenue quality, cash, delivery obligations and whether product claims can be delivered.
risksEn: Insolvency does not establish that every legal entity has dissolved; the subtype is a major commercial setback.
Historical revenue figures are publicly disputed and unverified amounts are excluded.
Media allegations are not treated as adjudicated facts.

name: Embodied / Moxie 原运营公司
summary: 原运营商 Embodied 于 2024 年宣布关闭，云服务依赖使机器人用户面临服务中断；后续有资产承接和社区维护，不能称 Moxie 永久消失。

sources.title: Maker of AI robots for kids abruptly shutters
sources.supports: Embodied 宣布关停及云依赖导致消费者设备服务风险。
sources.titleEn: Maker of AI robots for kids abruptly shutters
sources.supportsEn: Embodied's closure announcement and the consumer-service risk caused by cloud dependence.

sources.title: They bought an AI robot … the company is shutting down
sources.supports: CEO 向客户说明融资未完成，无法继续运营。
sources.titleEn: They bought an AI robot … the company is shutting down
sources.supportsEn: The CEO's account of a failed funding round.

sources.title: Moxie Robots Help and Support
sources.supports: 搜索索引中的后续运营方说明承接 Moxie 权利；当前页面重定向，后续状态需复查。
sources.supportsEn: Indexed successor information about acquired Moxie rights; the current page redirects and later status needs rechecking.

drivers.text: CEO 向客户说明新融资未完成，原公司无法继续运营。
drivers.textEn: The CEO told customers that a funding round failed and the original company could not continue operating.

drivers.text: 硬件功能依赖经营主体的持续云服务，形成停运后客户价值损失。
drivers.textEn: Hardware depended on the operator's cloud service, exposing customers to a loss of value after closure.

risks: 失败范围限于 Embodied 原运营主体；后续商业承接与开源保留路径需分别核实。
后续支持网页当前重定向，不能保证服务持续可用。
soloRelevance: 中：设计持续服务成本、离线能力、数据导出和产品停运交接。
summaryEn: Original operator Embodied announced closure in 2024. Cloud dependence exposed robot owners to service interruption. Later asset transfers and community maintenance mean Moxie should not be described as permanently gone.
soloRelevanceEn: Medium: plan continuing-service costs, offline functions, data export and handover when a product closes.
risksEn: The failure scope is the original Embodied operator; later commercial transfers and open-source preservation need separate checks.
The successor support page currently redirects, so continuing service cannot be guaranteed.

name: Ghost Autonomy
summary: Ghost Autonomy 于 2024 年 4 月停止全球运营；案例用于对照资本密集 AI 技术商业化。

sources.title: Ghost Autonomy ceased operations
sources.supports: 2024 年 4 月 3 日公告关闭全球运营、自动驾驶软件业务及约 2.2 亿美元融资。
sources.supportsEn: Worldwide operations closure announced on April 3, 2024, autonomous-driving software, and reported funding.

drivers.text: 大量融资和技术合作仍不能单独证明商业化完成；具体根因在选用报道中不足。
drivers.textEn: Funding and technical partnerships alone do not establish completed commercialization; the selected reporting does not establish a precise root cause.

risks: 融资不是收入或利润。
自动驾驶技术、监管和资金要求与 solo 软件差距很大。
根因证据不足，不能据此归因于模型或客户需求。
soloRelevance: 低到中：对照技术里程碑与付费交付里程碑的区别。
summaryEn: Ghost Autonomy ceased worldwide operations in April 2024. It serves as a comparison for capital-intensive AI commercialization.
soloRelevanceEn: Low to medium: distinguish technical milestones from paid-delivery milestones.
risksEn: Funding is not revenue or profit.
Autonomous-driving technology, regulation and funding needs differ greatly from solo software.
Root-cause evidence is insufficient; no model or demand failure is asserted.

name: Argo AI
summary: Argo AI 于 2022 年停止运营，股东转向更近期可交付的驾驶辅助；记录公司关闭，原因不能简化为裁员。

sources.title: Ford's shuttered unit Argo … government notice
sources.supports: Reuters 报道 Argo 已关闭。
sources.titleEn: Ford's shuttered unit Argo … government notice
sources.supportsEn: Reuters reporting that Argo had already closed.

sources.title: Ford withdraws petition seeking approval to deploy self-driving vehicles
sources.supports: Ford 表示规模化且盈利的全自动驾驶仍需很长时间，转向其他技术。
sources.titleEn: Ford withdraws petition seeking approval to deploy self-driving vehicles
sources.supportsEn: Ford's judgment on the long path to scaled, profitable fully autonomous driving and its technology shift.

drivers.text: Ford 公开判断全自动驾驶达到规模化和盈利仍有漫长路径，选择转向较近可实现技术。
drivers.textEn: Ford publicly judged that profitable, scaled fully autonomous driving remained a long way away and shifted to nearer-term technologies.

risks: 2022 年历史事件，不代表今天所有自动驾驶路线。
大型资本密集研发公司的关停不可作为 solo AI 成功率统计。
soloRelevance: 中：把技术愿景拆成近期能收费、能交付且成本可控的阶段。
summaryEn: Argo ceased operations in 2022 as its backers shifted toward nearer-term driver assistance. This record establishes company closure rather than using layoffs as the failure criterion.
soloRelevanceEn: Medium: split the technical vision into near-term stages that can be sold, delivered and kept within budget.
risksEn: A historical 2022 event, not evidence about every current autonomous-driving route.
A large capital-intensive research company's closure is not a solo AI success-rate observation.

name: Cruise Robotaxi 项目
category: AI 自动驾驶 / 运营服务
summary: GM 于 2024 年 12 月宣布不再投入 Cruise Robotaxi 开发，技术团队转向私人车辆；失败范围是 Robotaxi 商业项目。

sources.title: GM to refocus autonomous driving development on personal vehicles
sources.supports: Robotaxi 开发停止投入、规模化所需资源和竞争因素。
sources.titleEn: GM to refocus autonomous driving development on personal vehicles
sources.supportsEn: End of robotaxi-development funding, required scaling resources and competition.

sources.title: GM 2025 Form 10-K
sources.supports: 2025 年文件记载 Robotaxi 运营收尾投入，支持项目结束状态。
sources.supportsEn: The 2025 filing records spending to wind down robotaxi operations.

drivers.text: GM 指出规模化需要大量时间与资源，同时面临越来越激烈的 Robotaxi 市场竞争。
drivers.textEn: GM cited the substantial time and resources needed to scale and increasingly intense robotaxi competition.

risks: GM 与 Cruise 其他自动驾驶工作继续，不能称整个公司全部 AI 业务失败。
资本密集运营项目与 solo SaaS 的可比性有限。
soloRelevance: 中：明确扩张必须增加的交付、运营和服务资源，不把规模当作自动盈利。
summaryEn: GM announced in December 2024 that it would no longer fund Cruise robotaxi development and would refocus technical work on personal vehicles. The scope is the robotaxi commercial program.
soloRelevanceEn: Medium: specify the delivery, operations and service resources needed for expansion instead of assuming scale yields profit.
risksEn: Other GM and Cruise autonomous-driving work continued; this is not failure of all company AI activity.
Comparability between capital-intensive operations and solo SaaS is limited.

name: Poppy / Second Nature Computing
category: 主动 AI 助手 / 消费者
summary: Poppy 官方于 2026 年 8 月宣布停止销售与开发，并于 8 月 31 日结束服务；公告未公开经营指标或具体停运根因。

sources.title: Sunset – Poppy
sources.supports: 停止开发和订阅、2026 年 8 月 31 日服务结束及用户数据删除安排。
sources.supportsEn: End of development and subscriptions, August 31, 2026 service termination and data-deletion plan.

sources.title: Poppy: Building a Proactive AI Assistant
sources.supports: 创始工程师描述三人建设主动助手的团队工作；不是审计人数。
sources.titleEn: Poppy: Building a Proactive AI Assistant
sources.supportsEn: A founding engineer's account of three people building the proactive assistant; not audited headcount.

drivers.text: 团队宣布转向其他工作，不再继续开发；商业根因未披露。
drivers.textEn: The team said it was moving on and would not continue development; a commercial root cause was not disclosed.

risks: 官方称用户使用超预期，不能凭停运推断没有用户需求。
未披露营收或留存，不填造数值。
工程师页面属于个人团队自述。
soloRelevance: 高：主动助手须验证长期付费及支持义务；停运时提供退款和数据导出。
summaryEn: Poppy announced the end of sales and development in August 2026 and service termination on August 31. The notice did not disclose operating metrics or a specific commercial root cause.
soloRelevanceEn: High: validate long-term payment and support obligations for proactive assistants; provide refunds and data export on closure.
risksEn: The company said use exceeded expectations; closure does not establish lack of user demand.
Revenue and retention were not disclosed, so no values are invented.
The engineering page is a personal account by a team member.

name: Super AI（Aryan Agarwal 项目）
category: AI 模型路由 / 聚合
summary: 创始人自述多模型自动路由产品运行至 2025 年 3 月后关闭；案例代表其单个聚合项目，避免与同名产品混淆。

sources.title: Super AI Postmortem: Why an All-in-One AI App Didn't Work
sources.supports: 2024 年 3 月到 2025 年 3 月的项目、关闭决定及模型趋同导致价值下降的创始人复盘。
sources.titleEn: Super AI Postmortem: Why an All-in-One AI App Didn't Work
sources.supportsEn: March 2024–March 2025 project window, closure and the founder's explanation about model convergence.

drivers.text: 创始人认为通用模型能力趋同后，自动选择模型的差异化价值下降。
drivers.textEn: The founder believed that convergence in general model capabilities reduced the value of automatic model selection.

risks: 仅有创始人回顾，缺少独立产品和财务核验；应作为低置信度自述。
同作者的 Vibe AI 属相关样本，不能视作完全独立训练观测。
文章推广其新产品，其跨行业因果泛化未经证明。
团队规模未披露，small-team 仅表示创业项目语境。
soloRelevance: 高：验证聚合功能是否能被底层平台轻易替代，寻找工作流和分发优势。
summaryEn: The founder reports that this model-routing product closed in March 2025. The record concerns his individual aggregation project and must not be confused with products sharing its name.
soloRelevanceEn: High: test whether the underlying platform can replace an aggregation feature and seek workflow and distribution advantages.
risksEn: A retrospective founder account without independent product or financial verification; treat as lower confidence.
Vibe AI is reported by the same author; the two are not fully independent training observations.
The article promotes the author's new product and its cross-industry causal claims are unproven.
Headcount is undisclosed; small-team describes the startup context.

name: Vibe AI（Aryan Agarwal 项目）
summary: 创始人自述 AI 朋友项目于 2026 年 2 月关闭；早期互动较强，后续留存与长对话成本无法支持目标定价。

sources.title: Vibe AI Postmortem: Lessons from Building an AI Friend
sources.supports: 2025 年 3 月到 2026 年 2 月项目窗口、留存下降和单位经济问题的自述。
sources.titleEn: Vibe AI Postmortem: Lessons from Building an AI Friend
sources.supportsEn: March 2025–February 2026 project window and the reported retention and unit-economics problems.

drivers.text: 创始人称第三周留存下降，长上下文对话成本高于用户可接受的收费。
drivers.textEn: The founder reports retention falling by week three and long-context conversation costs exceeding the audience's acceptable price.

risks: 只有创始人自述，缺少具体队列留存、账单和价格证据，低置信度。
与 Super AI 同作者相关，不适合作为独立统计样本。
solo 标签表示单人主导叙述，实际人力未披露。
不能将作者对陪伴类别的概括外推为所有产品规律。
soloRelevance: 高：按活跃付费用户计算模型成本，区分新鲜感和长期使用。
summaryEn: The founder reports closing this AI friend project in February 2026. Early engagement was strong, but later retention and long-conversation costs did not support the target pricing.
soloRelevanceEn: High: calculate model cost per active paying user and distinguish novelty from sustained use.
risksEn: A founder report without cohort-retention tables, bills or pricing evidence; lower confidence.
Related to Super AI through the same author and not an independent statistical sample.
